findings.claim: The prompt tells the Engineer to read A6/A7 in contracts/CTG-0002.md, but A7 is not in the contract. The contract ends A6 at line 196 and has no A7 section. A7 exists only in work/rounds/R-0017/plan.md:288-297, and plan.md is not on the reading list. A7 is the only authority for inserting a synthetic auth.users/auth.memberships row for the default actor 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002. The CTG-0002.md:187-196 text of A6 authorizes only a portal.complaint row. An Engineer reading only the listed files would find no authority for the identity/membership write required at prompt line 41-43. They could then either block or write auth rows without citing any authority.
findings.fix: Point line 10 to work/rounds/R-0017/plan.md section Adendas A7 (lines 288-297) as the authority, or have the Architect copy A7 into CTG-0002.md next to A6. Require the report to cite A7 for the auth rows.

findings.claim: Item 1 requires the Portal fixture to provide identity and membership for the default actor. The prompt does not list the sources needed to do that safely: backend/database/ddl/02-auth.sql (auth.users; auth.memberships at line 68; the membership role and group tables at lines 86/93/108), the pattern in backend/database/seed/00-fixtures-core.sql:10/42-54, and backend/app/src/detran-runtime.ts:320-323. The TASK-0011 prompt listed them at lines 26-29. The prompt also sets no limits on this write. It does not say to add no role, permission or group rows (roles come only from the token, detran-runtime.ts:315-326). It does not require a .invalid e-mail domain and deterministic ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,user_id) idempotency like the core seed. It does not ban app.role bypasses beyond what portal-fixture.sh:21 already uses. It does not require the fixture to run before all four frontend phases and the restore. The default actor has no fresh membership, which is why the maestro used b0000002 (00-fixtures-core.sql:10/44). So RAIT, Dashboard and TEAT also depend on this row, not only Portal.
findings.fix: Add 02-auth.sql users/memberships, the 00-fixtures-core.sql membership lines and detran-runtime.ts DetranLocalTokenVerifier to the reference list. Require a users row plus a single memberships row, tenant a001, is_active, idempotent, with no rows in the membership role or group tables and no policy or RLS change. Require it to be applied after the DB_NAME guard and before the first backend-restart (smoke.mjs:463-496). Require the report to say that all four reads and the CH biometrics/council probes now run as the default actor.

findings.claim: Item 2 covers the literal command, the six operations, the requestId echo, the unknown reference, invalid body, 405/Allow, SefazAdapterError and closing in finally. It leaves out three parts of C-02-02 in CTG-0002.md:94-104 and 106-109. First, a deterministic requestId generated when no body is sent (GET), marked as test data and free of secrets. Second, the error envelope { requestId, error: { category, code, message, retryable, providerStatus } } with BUSINESS_ERROR for an invalid body, NOT_FOUND for an unknown identifier, and retryable=false. Third, the requirement that listening be IPv4-loopback only. It also does not say which errors go through SefazHttpAdapter and which need raw HTTP. The adapter methods have fixed verbs, so 405 and a malformed body cannot come through it, while the contract sensor requires the adapter's own normalization. The Inspector sensor at contract.test.mjs:594-614 checks only the markers and exit 0. An implementation that prints markers without these checks would pass that sensor and still fail the C-02-02 closure criterion (CTG-0002.md:259).
findings.fix: List these checks explicitly. Assert the generated requestId on the GETs. Assert category, code, retryable=false and providerStatus in the envelope for NOT_FOUND and BUSINESS_ERROR. For 405, assert the Allow header, sent as raw fetch to the mock. Assert that unknown reference and refund go through the adapter and end in a SefazAdapterError instance with the normalized category. Print each marker only after its check passes. Keep the static TS import behind a dynamic import after tsx/esm/api register, since sefaz-adapter-smoke.mjs:2 is static today.
